items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels suffered another dislocated left elbow, X-rays negative, expected to miss time; last occurrence he missed about a month. Ruled out after cart.
items.why: Dislocated left elbow bracing fall, same as prior injury which loosens joint.
items.implication: Marcus Mariota likely starts; Commanders pass catchers and rushing upside take hit for multiple weeks.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams suffered a hamstring injury, carted off after non-contact scramble; MRI Monday to determine severity. Seen with slight limp postgame.
items.why: Hamstring on scramble, carted, emotional exit.
items.implication: Could miss time; Bears will be cautious with mobility-dependent QB. Tyson Bagent potential starter.
items.opportunity: Backup QB and Chicago pass-catcher volatility.

items.text: Bucky Irving separating from Kenny Gainwell: out-snapped 51-23, carries 17-2, routes 22-12. Through 2 weeks opportunities 36-12. Tucker active no snaps.
items.implication: Irving locked as lead back; Gainwell clear handcuff only.
items.opportunity: Irving RB2/flex every week; handcuff Gainwell.

items.text: Rhamondre Stevenson lost another fumble (7th in 31 games), punished with playing time. NE needs TreVeyon Henderson explosiveness often, especially with AJ Brown out.
items.why: Fumble punishment + weapon-deficient offense + Brown absence.
items.implication: Henderson role expansion even without fumbles; Stevenson risky.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley will have MRI after stinger but hope is minor; he played through it after missing most of first half, returned with neck roll.
items.why: Stinger on opening drive, returned second half limited.
items.implication: Likely available Week 3 if MRI clean; monitor neck/stinger protocol.
items.opportunity: Limited touches if lingering; Tank Bigsby handcuff value short-term.

items.text: Ladd McConkey officially ACTIVE despite cracked rib (flak jacket expected); played through for 3/35. Was GTD with optimism.
items.why: Optimism from reports, limited practice Friday, Schefter confirmed active.
items.implication: Startable but decoy-ish volume possible while healing; better Week 3.

items.text: RJ Harvey inactive (hamstring); grab Jonah Coleman. JK Dobbins lead back.
items.why: Hamstring, not expected per ETR/Levitan, Schefter confirmed.
items.implication: Dobbins RB2/3 boost; Coleman deep stash/FLEX.
items.opportunity: Dobbins carries + pass game; Coleman designed touches.

items.text: Zay Flowers OUT (hamstring); opens door for Bateman.
items.implication: Ravens WR targets redistribute; Bateman primary beneficiary.

items.text: Michael Pittman OUT (foot); expecting look at Germie Bernard.
items.implication: Colts WR targets open; Bernard YAC fit with McCarthy.

items.text: Puka Nacua (hip) true game-time decision for MNF; missed practices.
items.why: Hip, no practice Sat, Levitan true GTD.
items.implication: Have contingency (Adams); if out targets shift.

items.text: DeVonta Smith RIDE OR DIE: target shares 27% and 38% first two games, leading all WRs in expected PPR points.
items.why: Elite target share and expected points model.

items.text: Marvin Harrison Jr down to 0.53 yards per route run; only a handful of WRs worse.
items.why: Extremely low YPRR efficiency through two weeks.
items.implication: Volume without efficiency; monitor for breakout or continued underperformance.

items.text: 49ers WR Mike Evans hip injury not believed serious by Shanahan; could have returned in 4th if needed. Demarcus Robinson high ankle.
items.implication: Likely full go Week 3; no long-term concern.

items.text: Raiders HC on Brock Bowers: close, very close to returning; looks great. Was doubtful/out Week 2.
items.implication: Potential return Week 3; elite TE upside resumes.
